text:
ana_supply: FYI Zeta emailed — A800 tranche price +20% due to supplier surcharge, ETA unchanged. They also flagged 2 DOA units and propose cross-dock RMA -> depot repair flow to avoid multiple returns.

chris_sre: +20% is rough. Which customers/pools would be impacted first?

evan_ops: EU edge reserved pool takes the hit next month. We can shuffle some us-east spares but cross-region transfers cost time.

ana_supply: Correction: ana_supply here — impact mostly EU-dedicated and a handful of latency-sensitive pods in apac. Zeta proposes repairing the 2 DOA at their EU depot instead of return-to-origin. Saves freight but we need depot SLA.

zeta_logistics_bot: Zeta Logistics: Depot repair SLO = 5 business days, repair warranty covers parts, courier inbound/outbound consolidated to single AWB reduces admin fees. RMA ref: ZETA-R-2026-042.

zoe_depot: Depot note: we can accept cross-dock repairs but need condition photos + SN list up-front. If parts unavailable we revert to replacement and ETA extends.

tanya_fin: If depot repair stays within 5d, what's net cost delta vs full RMA? Also need insurance claim handling for DOA.

zeta_logistics_bot: Zeta Logistics: Depot repair net cost ~A3 900 per unit vs A3 2,800 for full replace+freight. Insurance: we can file DOA claim, requires depot failure report + signed manifest.

chris_sre: Ops constraints: during repair window we lose node capacity. Can we hot-spare by temporary node tag reassignment? Evan, can provisioning tolerate ephemeral tag swaps for 48h?

evan_ops: Yes, we have a script to temporarily remap tags, but it needs manual approval to avoid audit noise. I can gate it behind a one-off change request.

ana_supply: Zeta also asks if we accept consolidated return labels on their manifest (they'll pick up both DOA and the 3 units that need standard refurb routing). That reduces pickup cost but we must ensure serial-level credits.

chris_sre: Serial reconciliation is mandatory. If vendor consolidates returns we need manifest CSV with old_serial,new_serial,action columns. Example:

old_serial,new_serial,action
ABC123,REPAIR-001,repair
DEF456,,destroy

zoe_depot: We'll also require photo evidence column and depot acceptance signature in the CSV.

tanya_fin: Approvals: finance can cover depot repair cost if total < A3 10k emergency budget. With +20% A800 pricing I need projected spend for next quarter. Ana can you push numbers?

ana_supply: Projected: baseline Q throughput 120 units -> with +20% cost up to A3 288k extra. But immediate cashflow impact for this tranche ~A3 24k.

evan_ops: Operational ask: prioritize repairs for the two DOA to minimize capacity pain. If depot repair queue >3d, escalate to replacement.

zeta_logistics_bot: Zeta Logistics: We can expedite depot queue to 48-72h for an expedite fee of A3 1,200 for the batch. Offer valid 8 hours.

chris_sre: Decision point: 1) accept depot repair + consolidated AWB and pay expedite to get repairs inside 72h, 2) request direct replacements air for DOA (more expensive), 3) refuse consolidation and force separate RMA (more admin). Pros/cons?

tanya_fin: Finance leans to depot repair + expedited fee if total < A3 6k for batch. Ana, can you negotiate depot expedite to A3 700?

ana_supply: I'll push for A3 700 and request manifest + photo template now. Zeta, hold expedite at proposed price 1,200 for 8h pending negotiation.

zeta_logistics_bot: Zeta Logistics: Expedited depot fee currently A3 1,200. We will await payment confirmation to prioritize. Manifest (partial) will be attached once expedite or standard PO confirmed.

evan_ops: I'll draft the remap CR and the small provisioning hook to map repaired serials back to original node tags. Pseudo: 

# remap if repair_complete
for serial in repaired_list:
  assign(serial, orig_node_tag)

zoe_depot: Also confirm HS code for cross-border pickup: HS 84733070. Without this customs may add delay.

ana_supply: Action list: 1) ana_supply to negotiate depot expedite and confirm with finance, 2) zeta to provide manifest/photo template, 3) evan to prepare remap CR and provisioning script, 4) zoe to confirm depot acceptance checklist. Hold decision for 6h.

chris_sre: I'll mark affected pods in the capacity tracker and open incident tag for EU-dedicated risk.

ana_supply: Thanks team. We'll reconvene once Zeta returns on expedite price. :white_check_mark:
